text: Ladies and gentlemen, cleared at the scale and climbing the realism charts, from fifty five up to fifty eight! This buzz cut brawler in charcoal and white hand wraps now throws, falls, gets back up, and finally plants his feet like he pays rent on the canvas. But somebody check that rash guard, ripples like a waterbed, a neckline sliding off the shoulder, and shorts with blotchy, ragged hems. Standing one point seven nine meters tall, over two hundred forty one thousand triangles strong, the Stubbled Storm himself, GROK!
